reading_context_receipt_result_coherent.name: reading_context_receipt_result_coherent
reading_context_receipt_result_coherent.value:
(
        "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."command_type" = 'clear'
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_kind" = 'cleared'
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_revision_id" IS NULL
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_revision_number" IS NULL

        "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."command_type" = 'set'
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_kind" IN ('created', 'updated')
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_revision_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "birth_profile_reading_context_mutation_receipts"."result_revision_number" > 0
      )
